description: POST /auth/login for a user with no api client creates the client and issues token pair (source user-login-flow)

probes.description: issued access token persisted on the new client
probes.sql: SELECT access_token FROM api_clients WHERE client_id = 'sf-int-client'

probes.description: new api client row linked to user with Salesforce id, active
probes.sql: SELECT user_id, salesforce_user_id, is_active FROM api_clients WHERE client_id = 'sf-int-client'
SELECT refresh_token_expires_at > now() + interval '29 days' AND refresh_token_expires_at <= now() + interval '31 days' FROM api_clients WHERE client_id = 'sf-int-client'
